== Notes ==
* A skill that changes your weapon damage type to earth damage, like [[Staggering Force]] or [[Dust Cloak]], will count as wielding an earth weapon.
* The added earth damage is [[Armor-ignoring damage|armor-ignoring]].
* [[Skill queue|Queue]] this skill while knocked down to avoid being [[quarterknock]]ed by physical attacks.
